label.explanation: notification-svc's heap filled steadily with old-gen objects that full GCs could not reclaim (lines 87, 117, 152) until it hit OutOfMemoryError and was OOMKilled, repeatedly (lines 162, 163, 200, 201, 233, 234). The "started notification-svc" lines (lines 168, 208, 237) are crash-loop restarts of the same version v2.7.4, not a deploy. The bursts of api-gateway 502s (lines 169, 182, 184, 195, 206, 217, 222, 230, 242, 247, 260, 265) line up with each crash. Red herrings: line 164 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path); line 170 (a single API client being rate-limited, which is the limiter working as intended); lines 145, 155 (a deploy of notif-worker, which is not on the failing request path and kept processing normally).
